dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Smooth, symmetrical 2D geometric narrowing from the mid-body toward the posterior peduncle, terminating in a sharp point.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Relatively smooth margins with a subtle, localized indentation visible on the right lateral edge in the posterior third of the frame.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Light-to-medium grey median intensity; dorsal surface is lighter (lower pigment) than the laterally submerged regions.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Diffuse, low-frequency darker grey shading concentrated around the anterior blowhole and along the submerged lateral boundaries.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradients with no sharp edges between varying levels of grey pigmentation.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: One distinct, high-contrast dark circular aperture at the anterior end (blowhole); one smaller dark spot on the dorsal midline posterior to the mid-section.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: A longitudinal shadow casting along the central dorsal axis in the posterior half, indicative of a raised dorsal ridge.

other_distinctive_markers: A sharply defined, linear dorsal ridge extending from the mid-body to the posterior tip.
